limitations: Zone fill connectivity is evaluated on a 0.1 mm raster; necks narrower than the raster may be misjudged
Thermal reliefs: relief gap and spoke width are derived from the zone clearance and net class (no per-zone/per-pad relief settings in the IR yet); vias and tracks connect solidly
The autorouter works on the two outer layers with through vias; inner-layer routing, blind and buried vias are placed by hand. Via aspect ratio and drill-to-layer-span limits are not checked
Pad shapes: rectangle, circle, oval (no rounded-rectangle or custom polygons)
not_implemented: Controlled impedance and signal integrity
Differential-pair length/skew matching
Thermal analysis and copper current density in zones (only relief-spoke width vs declared net current is checked)
Creepage (surface path) analysis — only voltage-based clearance (air gap) is checked
Silkscreen overlap/legibility, solder-mask sliver and paste checks
Keepout areas: EAK-IR has no keepout objects yet (needs a schema change and ADR)
Acid traps and copper slivers

limitations: Bodies are parametric boxes derived from library height and courtyard; real package shapes may differ
not_implemented: Enclosure fit (no enclosure model)
STEP model import and exact-solid collision

limitations: Fabrication profile: JLCPCB standard PCB (1-2 layer, FR-4) (https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities; retrieved 2026-11-14; verified = false). Values transcribed from the fabricator's public capabilities page for standard 1-2 layer FR-4 orders. Not verified against a quotation; the fabricator's current page and DFM review are authoritative.
A clean DFM report does not replace the fabricator's own DFM review of the generated files
not_implemented: Copper-to-copper gaps measured against the fabricator minimum (only the project rule is compared; DRC-002 measures geometry against the project rule)
Acid traps, copper slivers and starved thermals
Solder-mask web/dam width and mask-to-pad registration
Paste aperture ratios and stencil checks
Panelisation, V-score and castellated-hole rules
Controlled-impedance stackup matching
Assembly DFM (component spacing for pick-and-place, fiducials, tooling holes)
